description: E00 — 双象体系的隐形覆盖威力

intro.popup_en: Piece Coordination, Lesson 3: One bishop controls light squares and the other dark squares. Together, the bishop pair covers diagonals across the board.
intro.popup:
子力协调第3课
双象体系：一个象控白格，一个象控黑格
两象合力，整个棋盘斜线无死角！

outro.popup_en: The bishop pair is one of the strongest forms of coordination. With the rooks, the bishops can influence the entire board.
outro.popup:
总结：双象是最强的子力联合形式之一
双象+双车协调，控制全棋盘

moves.popup_en: d4 occupies the center and controls c5 and e5.
moves.popup:
d4占领中心
后翼开局，控制c5/e5

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops and controls e4.
moves.popup:
Nf6黑方出马
控制e4

moves.popup_en: c4! The Catalan advance offers a pawn and prepares the bishop's long diagonal.
moves.popup:
c4弃兵！
卡塔兰的特征推进
准备大象的对角线

moves.popup_en: ...e6 supports Black's center in a closed setup.
moves.popup:
e6黑方守中心
封闭体系

moves.popup_en: g3 prepares Bg2, where the Catalan bishop will control the long h1-a8 diagonal.
moves.popup:
g3！为Bg2做准备
激活：准备卡塔兰象
计划：Bg2将控制h1-a8大斜线

moves.popup_en: ...d5 occupies the center.
moves.popup: d5黑方占中心

moves.popup_en: Bg2! The Catalan bishop enters the long diagonal. This light-squared bishop is one of White's strongest pieces, though its pressure is still building.
moves.popup:
Bg2！卡塔兰象进场！
🏹 白格象登场：控制h1-a8对角线
激活：Bg2是白方最强的一枚棋子
注意：象现在只是蓄势，威力待爆发

moves.popup_en: ...Be7 develops defensively and reduces the pressure from Bg2.
moves.popup:
Be7黑方守备
抵挡Bg2的压力

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops and complements Bg2: the bishop controls the diagonal while the knight controls key squares.
moves.popup:
Nf3马出动
协调：Nf3与Bg2互补
Bg2控斜线，Nf3控格子

moves.popup_en: ...O-O secures Black's king.
moves.popup: O-O黑方易位

moves.popup_en: O-O secures White's king and activates the rook on f1. White can prepare Rfd1 to control the d-file.
moves.popup:
O-O白方易位
激活：Rf1进入游戏
计划：Rfd1控d列

moves.popup_en: ...dxc4 wins the c4-pawn, but the bishop on g2 now has a clearer line toward d5.
moves.popup:
dxc4黑方吃兵
黑方吃掉c4，但Bg2现在对准d5线路更通畅了！

moves.popup_en: Qc2 develops, connects the rooks, and supports the bishop's diagonal. White can later recover the pawn with Qxc4.
moves.popup:
Qc2后出动
激活：后在c2联结双车
协调：Qc2+Bg2，后支援象的斜线
计划：Qxc4夺回兵后后守c2

moves.popup_en: ...a6 prepares ...b5.
moves.popup: a6黑方准备...b5

moves.popup_en: Qxc4 recovers the pawn and restores material equality.
moves.popup:
Qxc4夺回兵
等量交换，局面平衡

moves.popup_en: ...b5 attacks the queen and forces it to retreat.
moves.popup:
b5黑方翼攻
逼后再退

moves.popup_en: Qc2 retreats to a useful coordinating square.
moves.popup:
Qc2后退守
后在c2是最好的联络位

moves.popup_en: ...Bb7! Black's dark-squared bishop becomes active on the long diagonal and challenges White's bishop on g2.
moves.popup:
Bb7！黑方象激活
黑方的黑格象终于出来了
控制g2-a8大斜线，与Bg2对抗

moves.popup_en: Bd2! White develops the other bishop. Bg2 controls light squares and Bd2 dark squares, completing the bishop pair's coverage.
moves.popup:
Bd2！黑格象激活！
激活：c1象出动，控制黑格斜线
🏹 双象体系完成！
Bg2（白格）+ Bd2（黑格）= 两象覆盖所有方向！

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops a knight to challenge the bishop pair.
moves.popup:
Nc6黑方出马
黑方想用马对抗双象

moves.popup_en: e3 reinforces d4 and stabilizes the center.
moves.popup:
e3稳固
加固d4，守住中心

moves.popup_en: ...Nb4?! Black's knight enters b4 and attacks Qc2, but the knight may become exposed.
moves.popup:
Nb4黑马冒进
黑马突入b4，攻击Qc2

moves.popup_en: Bxb4 exchanges White's dark-squared bishop for the knight. White accepts because the remaining bishop on g2 is powerful enough.
moves.popup:
Bxb4换象！
激活：黑格象换掉黑马
💡 白方愿意换掉一个象，是因为剩下的Bg2已足够强大

moves.popup_en: ...Bxb4 recaptures and restores the material balance.
moves.popup:
Bxb4黑方吃象
黑方夺回材料

moves.popup_en: Nbd2 develops White's second knight. The Catalan coordination is now Bg2 plus Nf3 and Nbd2 controlling central squares.
moves.popup:
Nbd2马补上
激活：第2个马进入游戏
协调：Bg2（白格象）+ Nf3+Nbd2（双马控格）
这是卡塔兰的核心协调：大象+双马

moves.popup_en: ...Rc8 activates Black's rook on the c-file.
moves.popup:
Rc8黑方车激活
黑方车控c列

moves.popup_en: Rfd1! White activates the final piece. Bg2 controls light-square diagonals, the knights control central squares, the rooks occupy the d- and c-files, and Qc2 connects the forces. Five pieces work together with no idle units.
moves.popup:
Rfd1！车进d列！
激活：最后一子入场
协调终结态：
♗ Bg2（白格象）控全棋盘白格斜线
♘ Nf3+Nbd2 控中心格子
♖ Rfd1+Rac1 控d列+c列
♛ Qc2 联结所有子力
✅ 5子全协调——无废子！
